dedupe_keys.name: unh water balance model ancillary data version 1 0 0

description: The University of New Hampshire provides these ancillary inputs for its Water Balance Model release 1.0.0. The package contains crop parameters, soil properties, irrigation attributes, glacier data and river-network information. Gridded NetCDF and GeoTIFF files have matching text initialization files; tables describe crop parameters. Spatial coverage combines global grids with basin-specific files, and resolution varies by layer. Many crop inputs are daily climatologies derived from MIRCA2000, while other inputs have their own reference periods. The university offers the compressed archive free under the GPLv3 terms stated in the data README. These inputs support water-availability and irrigation simulations. A limitation is that relative paths connect data and initialization files, so the provider advises preserving the directory structure. The package includes processed upstream sources and is not a uniform observation dataset. A newer version is listed separately on the same site. The model code has its own resource record; no data files were downloaded.
name: UNH Water Balance Model ancillary data version 1.0.0
